findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: <button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button> at line 73, followed by <fieldset id="row-dob"> at line 74
findings.fix: Move the View details button to after the Create account button, or consolidate its information into the form flow.
findings.violation: The View details button sits above the date-of-birth fields rather than after all fields end, placing a secondary action before required fields.

findings.evidence: <label id="name-label" for="name-input">Full name</label> at line 11 and <label id="legalname-label" for="legalname-input">Your name</label> at line 62 both collect the person's name
findings.fix: Remove the 'Your name' field or repurpose it if a different field is needed (e.g., legal name vs. display name with clear distinction).
findings.violation: This field asks for the person's name again after the form already requested Full name at line 12, duplicating the same information.

findings.evidence: font-size: 13px declared by its inline style
findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
This web address field is type text, so a phone does not show the keyboard built for it.

findings.fix: Remove the inline float styling and align this label above its field to match the rest of the form, or apply consistent side-by-side layout to all labels.
findings.violation: The Preferred contact time label is positioned beside its field using float:left, while all other labels in the form sit above their fields, mixing label alignment patterns.
